affectedCopies: DecisionInteraction ledger (per-decision audit record read by the decision-review/attention surfaces)

migration.name: 20260724160000_weight_inference_scoring_and_proposals
migration.backfill: additive only: three nullable columns on DecisionInteraction (scoredOptions, recommendedOptionId, chosenOptionId) plus one new table (WeightAdjustmentProposal). Every existing DecisionInteraction row is left with all three new columns null — the weight-inference adapter's query (scoredOptions/recommendedOptionId/chosenOptionId all not-null) excludes them by construction rather than misreading them. No existing row is modified, no column is dropped.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: existing rows are retained unchanged apart from three new nullable columns defaulting to null; the ledger remains append-only

fields.reason: persists the per-option feature vectors a gate actually scored (build-studio-gate.ts, work-pattern-review.ts) so a later weight-inference run can read chosen-vs-recommended vectors directly instead of re-deriving them; carries no data about a person, only structural axis scores authored in source (option-recommendation.ts) and a static option-description string
fields.provenance: BI-D88DFEEA Phase 1 gate instrumentation, ratified via principle_decide (2026-07-24)

fields.reason: records which option the kernel's commandment-only scoring (option-recommendation.ts) favored, so a later comparison against the human's actual choice can measure systematic override — never itself a decision, only an audit record of what the kernel would have picked
fields.provenance: BI-D88DFEEA Phase 1; computed in evaluatePerspectiveGate only when scoredOptions is supplied and the gate's own verdict was recommend/arbitrate

fields.reason: records which option a human actually chose (work-pattern-review.ts's existing approve/defer/reject action, already captured elsewhere on the row) so the weight-inference adapter can pair it with recommendedOptionId; not a new capture of human behavior, just a structured pointer into data the row already carried in humanOutcome.action
fields.provenance: BI-D88DFEEA Phase 1; sourced 1:1 from the existing WORK_PATTERN_REVIEW_ACTIONS/WORK_PATTERN_CASE_RESOLUTION_ACTIONS enum already written to humanOutcome

changes.lifecycleDisposition: new table; a proposal starts at status=proposed (an inference, never authoritative) and reaches a terminal status=ruled or status=rejected only via an explicit human ruling recorded with ruledByUserId/ruledAt — never auto-applied or auto-mutated. Never deleted; a ruled/rejected row is retained as the audit record of that ruling

fields.reason: domainClass/profileId/axis/direction/consistency/meanSeparation/sampleSize/entersAtConfidenceWeight are statistical evidence about a pattern of DECISIONS (aggregated across >=8 observations per weight-inference.ts's sample floor), not data about an identifiable person
fields.provenance: spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-23-decision-tier-rebalance-and-vector-epistemology-design.md §2.4; weight-inference.ts's existing sample-floor/consistency-floor guards (WEIGHT_INFERENCE_DEFAULTS, unit-tested)

fields.reason: the accountable-human record for a real governance ruling (accept/reject a weight-adjustment proposal) — the same accountability pattern EscalationCapture.resolverUserId already establishes for stance material, not a new class of personal data
fields.provenance: mirrors EscalationCapture.resolverUserId (existing, already-governed field on the same DecisionInteraction ledger)
fields.fieldPolicy: accountable-actor reference only; used to attribute a governance ruling, never a routing key or permission subject
